name: DTM Car Racing Demo
author: dtm3ds
description: It is a prototype car racing game demo as well as a YouTube tutorial if applicable. It uses the "WASD" Key to move. This game was created for the mobile platform. Just press the "Back" of your browser to quit the game. Have fun!
